2026-08-14-search-index-stale.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-14 PM (in-thread with Elizabeth, same day): not a stuck search index. Org preset-inc has been over its Sentry error-event quota since 2026-08-05T20:54 UTC — stats_v2 split by outcome shows accepted/category=error = 0 every day 08-06 through 08-14 (was 76,102 on 08-04), while client_discard/rate_limited climbed instead (reasons: error_usage_exceeded, ratelimit_backoff). lastSeen=2026-08-05 on every issue is therefore correct, not stale — nothing new has actually landed. The 08-12->08-13 '2.42x org-wide jump' (46,264->112,051) re-attributed to project superset-python alone, and it's a spike in rejected (ratelimit_backoff) volume, not accepted errors — not a real dashboard doubling. /api/0/subscriptions/preset-inc/ 404s on this token — no quota/reset visibility without org-owner billing access. DMed + corrected same thread (D0BBR2PPFQ9, ts=1786716266.840669); Elizabeth engaged live but thread has no billing-side resolution yet.
2026-08-14-search-index-stale.status: RECOVERED 2026-08-19, still ramping 2026-08-20 — org-wide volume-delta today: current 24h=21681 vs prior 24h=7705 (2.81x, nominally over the 1.5x org-wide-jump threshold). Checked top contributors before deciding whether this is news: SUPERSET-PYTHON-12EZ (acknowledged_baseline) is 13171/24h, ~61% of the total — cross-checked against its 7d-scoped count (18205/7d, i.e. ~2600/day average over the week including the near-zero days) and its historical peak_events_7d baseline (115244, i.e. ~16463/day pre-outage) — today's 24h rate is close to but still under that historical daily average, so this reads as 'still climbing back to normal,' not a re-escalation (not >=3x peak, no re-alert trigger). The rest of the org-wide total is spread across other pre-existing chronic issues that also resumed after the quota outage (SUPERSET-PYTHON-YE9 firstSeen 2025-12-11, MANAGER-PYTHON-40E firstSeen 2026-07-21, websocket/502/SSL/timeout infra-noise cluster A9F/VVE/XVB/YYS/YFN/VVF/VVG/A2F/F2/ZVK/13JV) — none newly created, none tagged is:escalating by Sentry, none individually crossing the New (>=100 events, firstSeen<=72h) or Escalating (>=500 events/24h) thresholds (max in either lens was 27 events, on unrelated small new issues from 08-19/08-20). Conclusion: this is the same 08-19 recovery event continuing to ramp toward steady-state, not new information — did NOT re-DM. Elizabeth still OOO per project_elizabeth_ooo_2026_08_18 (routine pings on hold, back ~08-25); the SUPERSET-PYTHON-12EZ fix is still the open PR apache/superset#43081 (sc-117145). Re-alert if: accepted volume drops back toward 0 (recovery reverses), any issue starts showing is:escalating with >=500 events/24h now that real signal is flowing, or 12EZ's 24h rate pushes past its ~16463/day historical average by a wide margin (would suggest genuine re-escalation, not just recovery ramp).
